# evroc_bucket_service_account (Resource)

Manages an evroc bucket service account for S3-compatible access credentials. Credential values are sensitive but are stored in state.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `buckets` (List of String) List of bucket names this service account can access.
- `name` (String) Name of the service account.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the service account will be created.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key ID.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the service account was created.
- `credentials_secret` (String) Identifier of the generated S3 credentials. Used by the `evroc_bucket_service_account_secret` data source for backward compatibility; new configurations can use `access_key_id` and `secret_access_key` directly from this resource.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) S3 secret access key.
- `service_account_id` (String) Unique identifier of the service account.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
